description: A dark oil painting of a night-time container port. A large steel gantry crane on the right lifts a shipping container above the deck of a dark-hulled cargo ship, with more containers stacked on the quay in the foreground and further cranes and ships fading into the background under a harsh overhead light. There is no visible text, no frame or border, and nothing graphic.
reason: Shows a container port with a gantry crane loading a shipping container onto a cargo ship, but the card is the first overland crossing of Antarctica (1958). It should show an expedition party with tracked vehicles and dog sledges on polar ice. The stacked-container port is also a modern-era look that does not fit 1958.
